metadata.title: Generic Cantor actions of Z wr Z are hyperfinite
metadata.description:
We give an affirmative answer to Question 3 in Iyer's contribution, joint with Shinko, to Oberwolfach Report 2/2025, printed page 115. A dense G_delta in the space of all continuous actions of the restricted wreath product Z wr Z on Cantor space has hyperfinite orbit equivalence relation on the entire space. The auxiliary Borel theorem assumes an equivariant profinite shift height and permits stabilizers. Finite-width lamp slabs satisfy the compatible-metric theorem of Conley, Jackson, Marks, Seward and Tucker-Drob; the entire exceptional integer-height preimage has a separate finite Borel exhaustion.

The generic-height construction is an explicit specialization of established principles of Akin, Glasner and Weiss, Doucha, and Doucha, Melleray and Tsankov, all credited in the note. Iyer and Shinko's baseline is cited as a published 2025 paper. A dated, bounded priority audit found no exact earlier resolution in the inspected corpus. No claim of historical firstness or certification of worldwide current openness is made.

The deposit contains a concise research note, editable proof source, preserved original evidence, fresh independent mathematical and priority reviews, portable finite diagnostics and integrity controls. OpenAI tools were used extensively in solving, drafting and verifying the result. This is an unrefereed preprint, with no completed external human peer review or formal proof-assistant certification claimed. Finite checks do not replace the infinite mathematical proof.
references: S. Iyer (joint with F. Shinko), Generic actions of countable groups, Set Theory, Oberwolfach Report 2/2025, pp. 114-115, Question 3. https://doi.org/10.4171/owr/2025/2
